"""逐项改坏31381启用链路，独立执行对应测试，并恢复全部文件。"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

root=Path.cwd();base=root/'data/openjudge/tests/30000-/31381_made'
rows=[]

def detect(name,path,broken,test):
    original=path.read_bytes()
    try:
        path.write_bytes(broken)
        run=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3.11','-B','-m','unittest','tests.test_31381_activation.Activation31381Tests.'+test],capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'),timeout=30)
        assert run.returncode!=0,name
        rows.append({'mutation':name,'path':str(path.relative_to(root)),'detected':True,'exit_code':run.returncode})
    finally:path.write_bytes(original)

catalog=root/'data/openjudge/catalog.json';obj=json.loads(catalog.read_text());entry=next(r for r in obj['problems'] if r['book']=='practice' and r['id']=='31381')
for name,key,value in [('未绑定SPJ','checker',None),('遗漏活动用例','test_count',20)]:
    old=entry[key]
    if value is None:del entry[key]
    else:entry[key]=value
    detect(name,catalog,json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2).encode(),'test_catalog_page_samples_and_checker_binding');entry[key]=old
cases=[
 ('缺失checker时仍允许精确判题',root/'scripts/index_tests.py',b'SPECIAL_JUDGE_GLOBAL_NUMBERS = {27150, 30193, 31381}',b'SPECIAL_JUDGE_GLOBAL_NUMBERS = {27150, 30193}','test_catalog_page_samples_and_checker_binding'),
 ('全局题号绑定错误',root/'data/openjudge/pages/practice__31381.html',b'<dd>31381</dd>',b'<dd>31382</dd>','test_catalog_page_samples_and_checker_binding'),
 ('列表漏掉新题',root/'data/openjudge/books/practice__11.html',b'class="problem-id"><a href="/practice/31381/">31381',b'class="not-id"><a href="/practice/31381/">31381','test_catalog_page_samples_and_checker_binding'),
 ('生成器丢失输入契约',base/'producecase.py',b"return isinstance(text, str) and re.fullmatch(r'[^\\r\\n]*(?:\\r?\\n)?', text) is not None",b'return True','test_generator_reproduces_all_tracked_bytes'),
 ('参考解错误忽略空格',base/'samplecode.py',b'return text[::-1]',b'return text.strip()[::-1]','test_generator_reproduces_all_tracked_bytes'),
 ('生成器产生重复输入',base/'producecase.py',b"return SHAPES[seed-1] + '\\n'",b"return SHAPES[0] + '\\n'",'test_generator_reproduces_all_tracked_bytes'),
 ('题面独立契约不拒绝多行',root/'tests/test_input_constraints.py',b"if '\\n' in body or '\\r' in body:",b'if False:','test_generator_reproduces_all_tracked_bytes'),
 ('数据样例被修改',base/'data/0.out',b'mnbvcxz',b'mnbvcxx','test_generator_reproduces_all_tracked_bytes')]
for name,path,before,after,test in cases:
    original=path.read_bytes();assert original.count(before)==1,name
    detect(name,path,original.replace(before,after),test)
source=Path(__file__).read_text();sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
(root/'collab/gmyhf-31381-activation-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'results':rows,'procedure_source':source,'procedure_sha256':sha(source.encode()),'tested_sources':{str(p.relative_to(root)):sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in (base/'producecase.py',base/'samplecode.py',root/'scripts/index_tests.py',root/'tests/test_31381_activation.py',root/'tests/test_input_constraints.py')}},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(len(rows),'种启用链路变异检出，全部文件恢复')
